questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: What was India's real GDP growth rate in Q1 FY27 (April-June 2026)?
questions.e: India's real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY27, beating the RBI's 7% projection, with GVA at 8.2%.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: What was the RBI's repo rate after the August 2026 monetary policy review?
questions.e: The RBI kept the repo rate at 5.25% in August 2026 — the fourth consecutive pause — with a neutral stance.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: What is the new basic customs duty on crude sunflower oil after the September 2026 duty cut?
questions.e: From 24 September 2026, basic customs duty on crude sunflower oil was reduced to nil, while crude palm and soyabean oil duty fell to 5%.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: How much suspected cyber fraud has the Financial Fraud Risk Indicator (FRI) prevented? (2026 figure)
questions.e: The Financial Fraud Risk Indicator prevented suspected cyber-fraud transactions of over Rs 5,000 crore, announced by the Communications Ministry.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Where did the 18th India-Mongolia exercise Nomadic Elephant commence in September 2026?
questions.e: The 18th India-Mongolia joint exercise Nomadic Elephant commenced on 21 September 2026 at Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Exercise Varuna is a bilateral naval exercise between India and which country?
questions.e: Exercise Varuna is the bilateral India-France naval exercise; the 24th edition saw INS Trishul arrive in Toulon.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: At which shipyard was the keel laid for the first Next Generation Missile Vessel (NGMV)?
questions.e: Cochin Shipyard Limited laid the keel of the first Next Generation Missile Vessel for the Indian Navy on 19 September 2026.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: With which company did the Defence Ministry sign the Rs 810.79 crore anti-airfield weapons contract?
questions.e: The Defence Ministry signed an Rs 810.79 crore contract with Bharat Dynamics Limited for anti-airfield weapons on 25 September 2026.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The Rs 586 crore auxiliary power unit contract signed by the Defence Ministry is for which platforms?
questions.e: The MoD inked a Rs 586 crore contract on 21 September 2026 for auxiliary power units for T-72 and T-90 tanks.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: EOS-05, launched by ISRO in September 2026, is India's first imaging satellite in which orbit?
questions.e: GSLV-F17 carried EOS-05 (GISAT-1A) into a geosynchronous orbit on 4 September 2026 from Sriharikota.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: What is the weight of the EOS-05 satellite, the heaviest payload of the GSLV Mark II?
questions.e: At 2,367 kg, EOS-05 is the heaviest satellite the GSLV Mark II has launched.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: NITI Aayog's PACT and ZET marketplace targets which segment?
questions.e: NITI Aayog launched the PACT and ZET marketplace on 7 September 2026 to accelerate zero-emission trucking in freight.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Where was the World Circular Economy Forum 2026 held in India?
questions.e: India hosted the World Circular Economy Forum 2026 (15-18 September) at Mahatma Mandir, Gandhinagar — the first South Asian host.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: What kind of organism is Oxyserphus narendrani, newly described from Assam in 2026?
questions.e: Oxyserphus narendrani, described by ZSI researchers in September 2026 from Dibru-Saikhowa, Assam, is the first Indian record of the genus.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: In which state was the new leafless orchid Gastrodia keyiensis discovered?
questions.e: Gastrodia keyiensis, the 'Ghost Flower' orchid described in September 2026, was found in Arunachal Pradesh's Keyi Panyor district.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: The new blind fish genus Gangaichthys indonepalicus was discovered in which state?
questions.e: Gangaichthys indonepalicus, a new genus of blind subterranean fish, was described from Indo-Gangetic aquifers in Bihar (ZooKeys 2026).

questions.subject: International
questions.q: Where did Jaishankar meet US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in September 2026?
questions.e: Jaishankar met US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in New York on 23 September 2026 during UNGA 81's High-Level Week, discussing the SRIA law.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: What is the maximum tariff rate authorised under the US Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026?
questions.e: The Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (SRIA) was signed on 18 September 2026, authorising tariffs of up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: By which year does India aim to eliminate Hepatitis B and C as public-health threats?
questions.e: India reaffirmed at UNGA 81 its goal of eliminating Hepatitis B and C as public-health threats by 2030.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Which city/region is hosting the 2026 Asian Games?
questions.e: The 20th Asian Games are being held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan from 19 September to 4 October 2026.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: What was the Asian-record score by Suruchi Singh and Kamaljeet in the 10m air pistol mixed team final?
questions.e: Suruchi Singh and Kamaljeet won the 10m air pistol mixed team gold with an Asian record of 484.6 points on 25 September 2026.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: In which sport did Suchika Tariyal win India's first-ever Asian Games medal in that discipline?
questions.e: Suchika Tariyal's bronze in the 60 kg traditional MMA event was India's first-ever Asian Games medal in MMA.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: Who presented the Bihar Economic Survey 2025-26 on February 2, 2026?
questions.e: The 20th Bihar Economic Survey 2025-26 was presented by Finance Minister Bijendra Prasad Yadav in the Assembly on February 2, 2026.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: Bihar's GSDP in 2024-25 at current prices stood at:
questions.e: Bihar's GSDP in 2024-25 was Rs 9,91,997 crore at current prices, growing 13.1% versus India's 9.8%.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: Which sector's share of Bihar's GSVA rose from 21.1% in 2020-21 to 26.8% in 2024-25?
questions.e: The secondary sector's share of Bihar's GSVA climbed from 21.1% in 2020-21 to 26.8% in 2024-25, driven by manufacturing and construction.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: The total outlay of Bihar Budget 2026-27 is:
questions.e: Bihar Budget 2026-27, the state's largest-ever, totals Rs 3,47,589.76 crore, about Rs 30,000 crore more than the previous year's Rs 3.17 lakh crore.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: The fiscal deficit estimated in Bihar Budget 2026-27 is Rs 39,111.80 crore, which is what percentage of GSDP?
questions.e: The fiscal deficit of Rs 39,111.80 crore is 2.99% of the projected GSDP of Rs 13,09,155 crore, within the 3% FRBM limit.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: Which department received the highest allocation in Bihar Budget 2026-27?
questions.e: Education received Rs 60,204 crore, the highest allocation in Bihar Budget 2026-27.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Under Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana phase one, how much DBT does each woman receive?
questions.e: Phase one of the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana gives a one-time Rs 10,000 DBT; those who use it can get up to Rs 2 lakh in phase two.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: From June 2025, the monthly pension under Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana is:
questions.e: The Vridhjan pension was raised from Rs 400-500 to Rs 1,100 per month, effective June 2025, credited by DBT on the 10th.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Bihar's heli-tourism phase one links Patna with Rajgir at what introductory one-way fare?
questions.e: Phase one heli-tourism introductory fares are Patna-Rajgir Rs 4,000, Patna-Valmikinagar Rs 5,000 and Patna-Kaimur Rs 6,000, with a Rs 2,100 joy ride.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The Plateau Area scheme of Bihar's 2026-27 fisheries special package gives what subsidy?
o: 70% on unit cost up to Rs 10.10 lakh
80% on unit cost up to Rs 16.70 lakh
50% on unit cost up to Rs 10.10 lakh
80% on unit cost up to Rs 10.10 lakh
questions.e: The Plateau Area scheme gives 80% subsidy on unit cost up to Rs 16.70 lakh (maximum Rs 13.36 lakh) for SC/ST/EBC applicants.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Samrat Choudhary became Bihar's chief minister on April 15, 2026 as:
o: Both first BJP CM and 24th CM
questions.e: Samrat Choudhary took oath on April 15, 2026 as Bihar's 24th Chief Minister and its first BJP chief minister.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: In the 2025 Bihar Assembly election, the NDA won how many of 243 seats?
questions.e: The NDA won 202 of 243 seats; BJP 89, JD(U) 85, LJP(RV) 19, HAM(S) 5 and RLM 4.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Pratyaya Amrit, Bihar's chief secretary from September 1, 2025, belongs to which IAS batch?
questions.e: Pratyaya Amrit is a 1991-batch IAS officer who took charge as Bihar Chief Secretary on September 1, 2025.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: The first phase of Patna Metro covers which three stations?
o: Patliputra Bus Terminal, Zero Mile, Bhoothnath
questions.e: Patna Metro's 3.45-km first phase covers Patliputra Bus Terminal (ISBT), Zero Mile and Bhoothnath.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: Which state hosted the 7th Khelo India Youth Games in May 2025?
questions.e: Bihar hosted the 7th Khelo India Youth Games from May 4 to 15, 2025, its first major multi-discipline event.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India beat New Zealand in the 2026 T20 World Cup final by:
questions.e: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final at Ahmedabad on March 8, 2026, winning its third T20 World Cup.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India became the first team to do what in the 2026 T20 World Cup?
o: Successfully defend the title and win as hosts
Win the toss in every match
questions.e: India became the first team to successfully defend the T20 World Cup and the first host nation to win it.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Who won the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
questions.e: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time, with Ferran Torres scoring in the 106th minute.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Who won the FIFA World Cup 2026 Golden Boot with 10 goals?
questions.e: Kylian Mbappe won the Golden Boot with 10 goals, his second straight, and became the World Cup's all-time top scorer with 22.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: RCB defended its IPL title in 2026 by beating which team?
questions.e: RCB beat Gujarat Titans by five wickets in the IPL 2026 final, becoming only the third team to defend the title after CSK and MI.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India finished fourth at CWG 2026 Glasgow with how many medals?
questions.e: India won 39 medals at Glasgow 2026: 13 gold, 17 silver and 9 bronze, finishing fourth.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Which city will host the centenary Commonwealth Games in 2030?
questions.e: Ahmedabad will host the centenary Commonwealth Games in 2030, announced at the Glasgow 2026 closing ceremony.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: At the Aichi Asian Games, Mirabai Chanu's 49kg silver ended a wait of how many years for an Indian weightlifting medal?
questions.e: Mirabai Chanu's 49kg silver ended a 28-year wait for an Asiad weightlifting medal since Karnam Malleswari's 1998 bronze.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Carlos Alcaraz completed the career Grand Slam at the 2026 Australian Open at what age?
questions.e: Alcaraz, aged 22 years 272 days, became the youngest man to complete the career Grand Slam at the 2026 Australian Open.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: The NISAR satellite launched in July 2025 is significant because it is:
o: The first Indian satellite to Mars
The world's first dual-frequency (L+S band) SAR satellite
questions.e: NISAR is the world's first satellite carrying both L-band (NASA) and S-band (ISRO) synthetic aperture radars, launched July 30, 2025.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: Which wetland became India's 100th Ramsar site in June 2026?
questions.e: Surha Tal, officially the Jai Prakash Narayan Bird Sanctuary in Ballia district of Uttar Pradesh, was designated India's 100th Ramsar site in June 2026, following Shekha Jheel (Aligarh) as the 99th in April 2026.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: Which three states received their first-ever Ramsar site designations in 2025?
questions.e: The 2025 batch of eleven Ramsar designations included Kopra Jalashay (Chhattisgarh), Khecheopalri (Sikkim) and Udhwa Lake (Jharkhand) - the first Ramsar sites for each of these three states.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: Which severe cyclonic storm crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Kakinada on 28 October 2025?
questions.e: Severe Cyclonic Storm Montha (25-30 October 2025) crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Kakinada on 28 October with sustained winds of 90-100 kmph. Shakhti was the Arabian Sea storm of early October.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: Among the 30 identified river-interlinking projects, which is the only one under implementation?
questions.e: Per the Jal Shakti Ministry's August 2026 Rajya Sabha reply, Ken-Betwa is the only one of the 30 identified ILR projects (16 peninsular + 14 Himalayan) to have entered implementation; the foundation stone was laid at Khajuraho on 25 December 2024.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Under the COP30 Belem Package, how much annual climate finance is to be mobilised by 2035?
questions.e: All 195 Parties at COP30 (Belem, 10-21 November 2025) adopted the Belem Package of 29 decisions, which calls for mobilising at least USD 1.3 trillion per year in climate finance by 2035 and tripling adaptation finance by 2035.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Which city will host COP31 in November 2026?
questions.e: After a brokered deal at COP30, COP31 was awarded to Antalya, Turkiye, to be held 9-20 November 2026, with Turkiye holding the presidency and Australia leading negotiations.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Which national park was declared India's 58th tiger reserve in March 2025?
questions.e: Madhav National Park in Shivpuri district, Madhya Pradesh, was declared India's 58th tiger reserve on 9 March 2025, giving the 'Tiger State' its ninth tiger reserve.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Which tiger reserve, notified as a national park in April 2025, is known for the world's only wild melanistic tigers?
questions.e: Similipal Tiger Reserve in Mayurbhanj, Odisha, was notified as a national park on 24 April 2025 - India's 107th national park - and is famous as the only wild home of melanistic (black) tigers.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: According to the UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2025, which two countries recorded the largest absolute increases in GHG emissions in 2024?
questions.e: UNEP's Emissions Gap Report 2025 ('Off Target') found global GHG emissions rose 2.3% in 2024 to 57.7 GtCO2e, with India and China showing the largest absolute increases, though India's per-capita emissions stayed below the world average.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: What did the CAQM's 21 November 2025 revision of the Graded Response Action Plan do?
o: It extended GRAP to Mumbai and Chennai
It pulled each stage's curbs one stage earlier
It made GRAP applicable only in summer
questions.e: On 21 November 2025 the Commission for Air Quality Management made the GRAP schedule more stringent by pulling each stage's measures one stage earlier - Stage IV curbs now apply at Stage III, and so on.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: At which event was the India-EU Free Trade Agreement concluded on 27 January 2026?
questions.e: The India-EU FTA was concluded on 27 January 2026 at the 16th India-EU Summit in New Delhi with European Council President Antonio Costa and Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, after negotiations that ran from 2007 to 2013 and were relaunched in 2022.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: When and where was the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) signed?
questions.e: India and the UK signed the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) on 24 July 2025 at Chequers in the presence of PM Modi and UK PM Keir Starmer; it entered into force on 15 July 2026.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: When did the High Seas Treaty (BBNJ Agreement) enter into force?
questions.e: The BBNJ (High Seas Treaty), adopted in June 2023 under UNCLOS 1982, entered into force on 17 January 2026 after crossing 60 ratifications. India signed in 2024 but had not ratified by then.

questions.subject: Schemes/Economy
questions.q: What is the approved outlay of GOBARdhan, the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme?
questions.e: The Cabinet approved GOBARdhan, the National Circular Bioenergy Scheme, on 6 August 2026 with a Rs 23,731-crore outlay (FY 2026-27 to 2035-36), aiming to grow domestic Compressed Biogas production nearly ten-fold.

questions.subject: Schemes/Economy
questions.q: How many first-time employees joined the formal workforce in the first year of the PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana?
questions.e: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, launched 1 August 2025 through EPFO, completed its first year with over 72 lakh first-time employees, nearly 30% women; first-time employees can get up to Rs 15,000.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: In September 2025, NDA nominee C.P. Radhakrishnan was elected India's 15th Vice President. Whom did he defeat?
questions.e: C.P. Radhakrishnan defeated the INDIA bloc's Justice B. Sudershan Reddy 452-300 to become India's 15th Vice President; the poll followed Jagdeep Dhankhar's resignation.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The 56th GST Council (September 2025) scrapped the 12% and 28% slabs. What new rate structure was created?
o: A single 18% rate for all goods
questions.e: The Council created a two-tier structure of 5% (merit) and 18% (standard), plus a 40% demerit rate for sin and luxury goods; individual life and health insurance were exempted.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: On 22 September 2025 the Election Commission delisted 474 Registered Unrecognised Political Parties. What was the stated reason?
o: Failing to contest any election in the preceding six years
questions.e: The ECI delisted 474 RUPPs for failing to contest any election in the preceding six years, as part of its periodic clean-up of dormant outfits.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The September 2025 protests in Ladakh demanded which constitutional safeguards?
questions.e: The agitation centred on demanding Sixth Schedule constitutional safeguards and statehood to protect Ladakh's land, jobs and culture.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: On 24 September 2025 violence erupted in Leh during the Ladakh protests. Which incident was reported?
o: The torching of a BJP office
The blockade of the Leh-Manali highway
The storming of the Raj Bhavan
questions.e: Violence erupted in Leh on 24 September, including the torching of a BJP office, prompting tear-gas use.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: The Bihar Mukhya Mantri Mahila Rozgar Yojana is targeted primarily at which group?
questions.e: It is a major Bihar-centric scheme delivering direct benefits to women, with PM Modi transferring the first instalment of Rs 7,500 crore on 25 September.

questions.subject: Bihar Special
questions.q: Under the Bihar Mukhya Mantri Mahila Rozgar Yojana, what was the amount of the first instalment transferred on 25 September?
questions.e: PM Modi transferred the first instalment of Rs 7,500 crore on 25 September under the scheme.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: On 26 September 2025 the IAF retired its last MiG-21s, ending 62 years of service. Which two squadrons were decommissioned?
questions.e: The IAF decommissioned No. 23 (Panthers) and No. 3 (Cobras) squadrons, ending the MiG-21's 62-year Indian service.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India won the Asia Cup 2025 final in Dubai against Pakistan by what margin?
questions.e: India beat Pakistan by five wickets; Tilak Varma's unbeaten 69 and Kuldeep Yadav's 4/30 powered a record-extending ninth title.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: NISAR, which sent its first Earth images on 30 September 2025, is a joint mission of which two agencies?
questions.e: The NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar satellite NISAR marks a landmark in India-US space cooperation in Earth observation.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The ICC Women's ODI World Cup 2025, which began on 30 September 2025, is co-hosted by which two countries?
questions.e: The tournament is co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: In its 1 October 2025 meeting, the RBI's MPC held the repo rate at 5.5% and raised the FY26 GDP growth forecast from 6.5% to what?
questions.e: Governor Sanjay Malhotra's panel raised the FY26 GDP growth forecast to 6.8% (from 6.5%) and cut the CPI inflation projection to 2.6% (from 3.1%).

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: 'Mahe', handed over to the Indian Navy by Cochin Shipyard on 24 October, is the lead vessel of which class?
o: An entirely home-designed class of shallow-water anti-submarine warships
A class of nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarines
A class of landing platform docks
A class of offshore patrol vessels
questions.e: 'Mahe' is the lead vessel of an entirely home-designed class of shallow-water anti-submarine warships for guarding coastal waters and sea lanes.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: On 24 October the United States sanctioned the President of which country, escalating a counternarcotics standoff?
questions.e: The US sanctioned Colombian President Gustavo Petro, escalating the counternarcotics standoff between Washington and Bogota.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.q: Severe Cyclone Montha made landfall on 28 October 2025 near which place on the Andhra Pradesh coast?
questions.e: Cyclone Montha made landfall near Kakinada with winds of 90-100 kmph gusting to 110 kmph, damaging crops across 38,000-plus hectares.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: 'Ikshak', commissioned at Kochi on 6 November 2025, is the Navy's third vessel of which class?
questions.e: The Navy's third survey vessel of her class, 'Ikshak' strengthens India's hydrographic survey and ocean-mapping capacity.

questions.subject: Miscellaneous
questions.q: Uttarakhand, carved out of Uttar Pradesh in 2000, is India's which-numbered state?
questions.e: Uttarakhand was carved out of Uttar Pradesh in 2000 as the 27th state of India.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: After Javokhir Sindarov became the youngest-ever FIDE Chess World Cup champion in Goa, the trophy was renamed in honour of whom?
questions.e: The trophy was renamed the Viswanathan Anand Cup; the top three finishers qualified for the 2026 Candidates Tournament.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The VB-G Ram G Bill passed on 18 December 2025 replaces MGNREGA with how many days of guaranteed rural wage employment?
questions.e: The Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission guarantees 125 days of rural wage employment (up from MGNREGA's 100), funded 60:40 Centre-states (90:10 for NE/Himalayan states and UTs).

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The SHANTI Bill, passed on 18 December 2025, replaces which two Acts?
o: The Electricity Act, 2003 and the Energy Conservation Act, 2001
The Mines and Minerals Act, 1957 and the Oilfields Act, 1948
The Environment Protection Act, 1986 and the Air Act, 1981
The Atomic Energy Act, 1962 and the Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act, 2010
questions.e: The SHANTI Bill replaces both Acts, opens civil nuclear energy to regulated Indian private participation, and grants AERB statutory status.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: ICGS 'Samudra Pratap', built by Goa Shipyard Limited and dedicated to the nation on 5 January 2026, is India's first indigenous vessel of which type?
questions.e: It is India's first indigenous pollution-control vessel, giving the Indian Coast Guard a dedicated marine pollution-response platform.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: CSIR-NPL's National Environmental Standard Laboratory, inaugurated on 5 January 2026, is Asia's first facility for what?
o: Testing and certifying air-pollution monitoring devices
questions.e: It is the world's second and Asia's first facility for testing and certifying air-pollution monitoring devices, supporting the National Clean Air Programme.

questions.subject: Miscellaneous
questions.q: On 6 January 2026, Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan released 55 scholarly works in which languages?
o: Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, Odia and Tamil classics
questions.e: The 55 works covered Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, Odia and Tamil classics, along with a 45-episode sign-language series on the Tirukkural.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: On 7 January 2026 the US withdrew from 66 international bodies. Which India-led body was among them?
questions.e: The US withdrew from 66 bodies including the India-led International Solar Alliance, IRENA, IPCC, IUCN, UNFCCC, UNFPA and UN Water, and exited the WHO after 78 years.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: India became the world's first country to commercially produce bio-bitumen using which feedstock, as announced by Nitin Gadkari on 7 January 2026?
questions.e: The CSIR-developed technology converts paddy straw through pyrolysis; 15% blending in bitumen can save roughly Rs 4,500 crore in foreign exchange.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: ISRO's PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 mission (the 64th PSLV flight) suffered a third-stage anomaly on 12 January 2026. Which DRDO strategic surveillance satellite was on board?
questions.e: The mission carried DRDO's strategic surveillance satellite Anvesha plus 15 co-passengers, and was NSIL's ninth dedicated commercial launch.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: The UN High Seas Treaty, which entered into force on 17 January 2026 after ratification by 60+ countries, covers which areas?
questions.e: It is the first legally binding agreement covering ocean areas beyond national jurisdiction, governing marine biodiversity, EIAs and benefit-sharing.

questions.subject: Miscellaneous
questions.q: India's first sleeper Vande Bharat Express, flagged off on 17 January 2026, runs on which route?
questions.e: The maiden sleeper Vande Bharat runs Howrah-Kamakhya (Guwahati), departing from Malda Town in West Bengal, with berths for overnight journeys.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: The rare red aurora seen over Hanle, Ladakh, on 19-20 January 2026 was triggered by what combination?
o: An X-class solar flare and a 1,700 km/s coronal mass ejection
A lunar eclipse and a geomagnetic reversal
A volcanic eruption and atmospheric ionisation
A meteor shower and stratospheric warming
questions.e: An X-class solar flare and a 1,700 km/s CME produced a G4 geomagnetic and S4 solar-radiation storm, the fiercest since 2003 - India's first well-documented red aurora.

questions.subject: Awards
questions.q: Of the 131 Padma Awards 2026 announced on Republic Day eve, how many were Padma Shri?
questions.e: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri; Maharashtra topped the state tally with 15 awardees.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Who were the chief guests at India's 77th Republic Day celebrations on 26 January 2026?
o: The US President and the UK Prime Minister
The French President and the German Chancellor
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa
The Japanese PM and the Australian PM
questions.e: The theme was '150 Years of Vande Mataram'; the parade was the first held after Operation Sindoor and featured about 10,000 special guests.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement concluded at the 16th India-EU Summit on 27 January 2026 was hailed by what name?
questions.e: The FTA was hailed as the 'Mother of All Deals', among the most significant trade pacts India has signed.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Alongside the FTA at the 16th India-EU Summit, India signed its first-ever Defence and Security Partnership with the EU. Which EU instrument does it open to Indian companies?
questions.e: The pact opens the EU's SAFE defence financing instrument to Indian companies, deepening defence-industrial cooperation.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: In the Union Budget 2026-27, presented on 1 February 2026, the fiscal deficit target was set at what percentage of GDP?
questions.e: Nirmala Sitharaman's ninth consecutive Budget targeted a fiscal deficit of 4.3% of GDP with capex of Rs 12.2 lakh crore.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The 16th Finance Commission retained the states' share in the vertical devolution of central taxes at what percentage for 2026-31?
questions.e: Announced on 3 February 2026, the share stays at 41%; urban local body grants rise 230% to Rs 3.56 trillion.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: Tarique Rahman became Bangladesh's 11th Prime Minister on 17 February 2026 after his party swept 212 of 299 seats. Which party?
questions.e: BNP swept 212 of 299 parliamentary seats, making Tarique Rahman Bangladesh's 11th PM.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: KHANJAR-XIII, the 13th edition held at Missamari (4-17 Feb 2026), is the bilateral exercise between India and which country?
questions.e: KHANJAR-XIII was the India-Kyrgyzstan exercise; the same month saw DHARMA GUARDIAN with Japan and VAJRA PRAHAR with the US.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The IAF's Vayushakti-26 firepower demonstration took place on 27 February 2026 at which location?
questions.e: Vayushakti-26 was held at Pokhran; on the naval side INS Anjadip was commissioned and CTS 'Krishna' launched.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: INS Anjadip, commissioned in February 2026, is the third Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft built by which shipyard?
questions.e: INS Anjadip is the third ASW shallow water craft built by GRSE; CTS 'Krishna' was launched at L&T Kattupalli.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: INS Taragiri, commissioned at Visakhapatnam on 3 April 2026, is a 6,670-tonne Project 17A warship built by which shipyard?
questions.e: The advanced stealth frigate built by Mazagon Dock carries over 75% indigenous content.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: During his 27-28 April 2026 visit to Sikkim, PM Modi inaugurated development projects worth approximately how much?
questions.e: PM Modi inaugurated development projects worth about Rs 4,000 crore in Sikkim.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Suvendu Adhikari's swearing-in as West Bengal Chief Minister on 9 May 2026 ended 15 years of rule by which party?
questions.e: The swearing-in ended 15 years of Trinamool Congress rule and installed a BJP-led government for the first time in the state.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: BIS notified IS 19850:2026 - India's first fuel-quality standard for petrol blends beyond E20. Which blends does it cover?
questions.e: Effective 15 May 2026, IS 19850:2026 covers E22, E25, E27 and E30 as the country moves past the 20% ethanol-blending milestone.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: In the 2026 Kerala Assembly results, the UDF won 102 of 140 seats. How many did the Congress alone secure?
questions.e: The UDF returned to power after a decade with 102 of 140 seats, the Congress alone securing 63; V. D. Satheesan became CM.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Lt Gen N. S. Raja Subramani took over on 31 May 2026 as India's which-numbered Chief of Defence Staff?
questions.e: He is India's third CDS, additionally serving as Secretary of the Department of Military Affairs.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Royal Challengers Bengaluru won the IPL 2026 final on 31 May at Ahmedabad, defeating which team?
questions.e: RCB beat Gujarat Titans by five wickets; Virat Kohli's unbeaten 75 led the side home.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Under whose captaincy did Royal Challengers Bengaluru win the IPL 2026?
questions.e: Under Rajat Patidar's captaincy, RCB defeated Gujarat Titans by five wickets.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: R Praggnanandhaa became the first Indian to win Norway Chess on 5 June 2026. Whom did he beat in the final round to seal the title?
questions.e: He defeated top-ranked Magnus Carlsen twice and sealed the title with a final-round win over Vincent Keymer.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: On 10 June 2026 Narendra Modi became India's longest-serving continuously elected Prime Minister with 4,399 days in office. By how many days did he surpass Jawaharlal Nehru's elected-tenure record?
questions.e: Modi's 4,399 days surpassed Nehru's 4,398 days - a margin of just one day, per PIB.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: After the original 3 May exam was cancelled on 12 May, the NEET-UG 2026 re-examination was held on which date?
questions.e: The re-exam was held smoothly on 21 June 2026 with over 20 lakh candidates; the NTA reported no paper-leak complaints.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Match the 1 July 2026 tri-services appointments: (a) Vice Chief of Air Staff, (b) AOC-in-C Southern Air Command, (c) Chief of Integrated Defence Staff - with (i) Jasvir Singh Mann, (ii) Ashutosh Dixit, (iii) Tejinder Singh.
questions.e: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit became VCAS, Air Marshal Jasvir Singh Mann took over Southern Air Command, and Air Marshal Tejinder Singh became CISC; Lt Gen Rajesh Pushkar assumed Army Southern Command.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: PM Modi's three-nation tour of 7-11 July 2026 included New Zealand - the first Indian prime-ministerial visit there in how many years?
questions.e: The tour covered Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand; ties with NZ were raised to a Strategic Partnership anchored in a 'Roadmap to 2030'.

questions.subject: Awards
questions.q: On 7 July 2026, Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto conferred which honour - Indonesia's highest civilian award - on PM Modi?
questions.e: The Bintang Adipurna was conferred in Jakarta for strengthening India-Indonesia relations; Modi dedicated it to the people of India.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under the India-UK CETA that came into force on 15 July 2026, the UK is eliminating or reducing tariffs on what share of its tariff lines?
questions.e: Described as a 'gold standard' deal, it has the UK eliminating/reducing tariffs on 98.8% of tariff lines; the Double Contribution Convention on social security also took effect.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: At its 3-5 August 2026 meeting, the RBI's MPC held the repo rate at 5.25% and trimmed the FY27 CPI forecast to what?
questions.e: The GDP forecast for FY27 was raised to 6.7% and CPI trimmed to 5.0%; Governor Sanjay Malhotra cited resilient demand and easing supply disruptions.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: PM Modi's Red Fort address on the 79th Independence Day (15 August 2026) lasted a record 103 minutes. Which number consecutive address was it?
questions.e: It was his 13th consecutive Red Fort address, with themes 'Naya Bharat', '150 Years of Vande Mataram' and 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India won the Test series 1-0 in Sri Lanka after the second Test at Colombo ended in what result on 27 August 2026?
o: An Indian win by an innings
questions.e: The second Test ended in a draw, giving India a 1-0 series win; Sonal Dinusha's unbeaten 133 while following on saved Sri Lanka.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: In the second Test at Colombo, whose unbeaten 133 while following on saved Sri Lanka against India?
questions.e: Sonal Dinusha's unbeaten 133, scored while following on, saved Sri Lanka after India declared at 503-9; debutant spinner Saransh Jain was among India's wicket-takers.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under NPCI's revised UPI MDR framework, the 0.4% charge on merchant transactions above Rs 2,000 is capped at how much per transaction?
questions.e: The 0.4% charge applies to P2M UPI transactions above Rs 2,000, capped at Rs 300 per transaction; person-to-person transfers remain free.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: HAL handed over LCA Tejas FOC trainers, HTT-40 'Ankur' trainers and Dhruv NG helicopters in September 2026. What is special about the Dhruv NG?
o: India's first indigenous civil helicopter, AS-4 compliant
questions.e: The Dhruv NG is India's first indigenous civil helicopter with AS-4 compliance, opening up civilian markets.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Asia's first Telecom Manufacturing Zone is coming up in which city?
questions.e: The zone in Gwalior involves about Rs 5,500 crore investment and 18,000+ jobs under a DoT-MP MoU.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: According to the FCRA (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, what happens to assets created from foreign funds if an NGO's registration is cancelled or lapses?
o: They are returned to the foreign donors
They vest in a government-appointed authority
They are auctioned by the NGO
They are transferred to the state government
questions.e: The Bill provides that such assets vest in a government-appointed authority; since 2015, 22,496 NGO registrations have been cancelled.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The IAF will host the second edition of the multinational air exercise Tarang Shakti at Jodhpur during which dates?
questions.e: The second edition runs 26 September-12 October 2026 at Jodhpur with complex air-combat drills.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Which Indian ships represented India at the 13th edition of SLINEX, the India-Sri Lanka bilateral naval exercise off Visakhapatnam?
o: INS Kavaratti and the fleet tanker INS Jyoti
questions.e: The 13th SLINEX was conducted off Visakhapatnam with INS Kavaratti and INS Jyoti representing India.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: 'KAL', flight-tested at Pokhran, is India's first home-grown long-range one-way-attack drone. What payload can it carry?
questions.e: KAL can strike targets about 1,000 km away, stay airborne seven to eight hours, and carry a 50-kg payload.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: The WMO's State of Global Water Resources 2025 reports that what percentage of monitored groundwater stations sat below normal levels?
questions.e: 34% of monitored groundwater stations were below normal; parts of India showed persistent depletion through 2022-25.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The 20th Asian Games opened in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, under which theme?
questions.e: The theme was 'Harmonic Heart Beat'; Manu Bhaker and Pawan Sehrawat carried India's flag, and teqball debuted.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Savita Punia became India's most-capped women's hockey player with 321 senior caps, passing Vandana Katariya's record of how many?
questions.e: Savita Punia's 321st cap passed Vandana Katariya's 320; Hockey India marked it with a Rs 10 lakh reward.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Under the 'Aadi' programme, 2,550 farmers in Punjab and Haryana received over Rs 2.9 crore for what?
questions.e: Farmers were paid for carbon sequestered in their soils - a landmark for agri carbon markets in India, covering about 50,000 verified credits.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: The crewed submersible MATSYA-6000 is being developed under which mission?
questions.e: Under the Deep Ocean Mission, MATSYA-6000 is under development; India holds three ISA exploration contracts covering about 95,000 sq km.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: The new leafless orchid 'Gastrodia keyiensis', found along the Keyi River in Arunachal Pradesh, is nicknamed what?
questions.e: Nicknamed the 'Ghost Flower', it was described in the journal Phytotaxa on 9 September 2026.

questions.subject: Environment
questions.q: Leopardus tilcayo, the first new living feline species described in over a century, was identified in which country?
questions.e: Scientists identified the new wildcat species from Bolivia - a rare mammalian-taxonomy breakthrough.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: RBI's bond sales and FX interventions cut the banking system's liquidity surplus to Rs 4.92 trillion on 21 September. This was down what percentage from the record Rs 11.16 trillion?
questions.e: The surplus fell 55% from the record Rs 11.16 trillion; the RBI sold Rs 750 billion of bonds in a week with Rs 250 billion more planned.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: ANZ expects three 25-basis-point RBI rate hikes from October 2026, taking the repo rate to what level by end-FY27?
questions.e: ANZ expects three 25-bp hikes from October 2026, taking the repo rate to 6.00% by end-FY27.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: From 18 September 2026, FPIs registered with urban and rural co-operative banks get simplified KYC certification on par with whom?
questions.e: The RBI move puts FPIs at co-operative banks on par with NRIs/PIOs - no physical in-person verification under PMLA norms.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Commodity derivatives in India are regulated by which body?
questions.e: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey pushed for banks and pension funds to enter commodity derivatives; commodity derivatives are regulated by SEBI.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: At Tarang Shakti 2026 (26 September-12 October, Jodhpur), which aircraft will fly alongside the IAF for the first time?
questions.e: US F-35s will fly alongside the IAF for the first time; seven friendly air forces bring assets, with 32 nations as observers.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: The first-ever V4+India Foreign Ministers' Meeting took place on 21 September in New York. Which countries form the V4?
o: Vietnam, Venezuela, Vanuatu and Vatican City
questions.e: EAM Jaishankar met counterparts from Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia on the sidelines of the 81st UNGA; the V4 backed India's permanent UNSC seat bid.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: Ireland's Data Protection Commission fined Google EUR 403 million on 21 September for GDPR breaches involving data from which period?
questions.e: The EUR 403 million fine covered Web & App Activity, Location History and Location Accuracy data from 2018-20; Google must comply within six months.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Suchika Tariyal won India's first-ever Asian Games medal in MMA - bronze in which category?
questions.e: She won bronze in the women's traditional 60kg category on 21 September after losing her semifinal to Singapore's Teo Hui Hoon.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The men's 10m air rifle team that won silver at the Asian Games on 21 September comprised which shooters?
o: Rudrankksh Patil, Parth Mane and Himanshu Dhillon
Divyansh Panwar, Arjun Babuta and Sandeep Singh
Rudrankksh Patil, Divyansh Panwar and Arjun Babuta
Aishwary Pratap, Swapnil Kusale and Akhil Sheoran
questions.e: Rudrankksh Patil, Parth Mane and Himanshu Dhillon won the silver in men's 10m air rifle team.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The Defence Ministry's Rs 810.79 crore contract with BDL is for how many Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons (SAT-SAAW)?
questions.e: The 23 September 2026 contract covers 160 DRDO-designed precision glide bombs with 60% indigenous content, to arm Jaguar, Hawk and Su-30MKI aircraft.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: DRDO's indigenous truck-mounted laser weapon, moving toward production, belongs to which class and is part of which project?
questions.e: The 30kW-class laser can engage drone swarms up to 5 km away; it is part of Project Sudarshan Chakra, with 50kW and 100kW variants in the works.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The 22nd edition of Exercise Yudh Abhyas - the India-US joint exercise - was held at which range?
questions.e: The 22nd Yudh Abhyas saw joint artillery drills at Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan, with M777 howitzers, Dhanush guns, Pinaka MBRLs and M-LIDS; it spans Rajasthan and Uttarakhand.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Tata Advanced Systems' facility inaugurated at Berrechid, Morocco, will build how many WhAP 8x8 armoured vehicles for the Royal Moroccan Army?
questions.e: The 20,000 sq-m facility will build 150 WhAP 8x8 vehicles over three years - the largest contract ever for Indian-made armoured vehicles.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under SEBI's PMS overhaul, the new mutual-fund-only PMS requires a minimum investment of Rs 25 lakh against the standard PMS minimum of how much?
questions.e: The MF-only PMS has a Rs 25 lakh minimum (vs Rs 50 lakh) and Rs 2 crore net worth (vs Rs 5 crore); the Board also proposed a Credit Risk-o-Meter and vault-manager rules.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Which company got SEBI approval on 24 September to offer custodial services?
questions.e: Motilal Oswal Custodial Services got SEBI approval to offer safekeeping, trade settlement, corporate actions and regulatory reporting; operations begin in Q4 2026.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Per the Finance Ministry's 23 September clarification via PIB Fact Check, the 0.4% UPI MDR applies to which transactions?
questions.e: Person-to-person UPI stays free, merchant payments up to Rs 2,000 stay free, and the 0.4% MDR applies only on specified person-to-merchant transactions above Rs 2,000, capped at Rs 300.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The Cabinet raised the mandatory EPF wage ceiling from Rs 15,000 to Rs 25,000 per month, effective 17 September 2026. When was it last revised before this?
questions.e: It was the first revision in about 12 years (since September 2014); around 51 lakh more employees are expected under EPF coverage.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: At the first-ever P4M Summit co-chaired by EAM Jaishankar, he stressed action on the '4F' crisis. What are the 4 Fs?
questions.e: P4M stands for Partners for Multilateralism, International Law, Peace & Prosperity; the 4F crisis covers fuel, food, fertiliser and finance.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Naorem Roshibina Devi became the first Indian to do what at the Asian Games?
o: Win two medals at one Games
Medal at three successive Asian Games
Defeat a Chinese opponent in a final
questions.e: She took silver in women's 60kg sanda, losing 0-2 to China's Zhang Xiaoyu - her third successive Asian Games medal (bronze 2018, silver 2022, silver 2026).

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Satnam Singh and Salman Khan won bronze in which rowing event at the Asian Games on 24 September?
questions.e: The pair won bronze in men's double sculls (6:13.25), finishing behind China and Uzbekistan.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Elena Rybakina beat Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the US Open women's singles final on 12 September. What did this deny Sabalenka?
questions.e: The win denied Sabalenka a three-peat; it was Rybakina's third Grand Slam title after the 2026 Australian Open and Wimbledon 2022.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Ayushman Bharat, which turned eight on 23 September, provides annual health insurance cover of how much per the capsule?
questions.e: The world's largest healthcare scheme covers over 60 crore beneficiaries with Rs 5 lakh annual cover; 48.54 crore Ayushman cards have been issued.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: At the 20th Rozgar Mela on 19 September, PM Modi handed out how many appointment letters across 45 locations?
questions.e: Over 51,000 appointment letters were handed out - about 12.75 lakh in total through the Mela series.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana spotlighted at the 20th Rozgar Mela offers first-time job seekers an incentive of how much?
questions.e: The scheme (around Rs 1 lakh crore outlay, about 2 crore first-time youth) offers a Rs 15,000 incentive for first-time job seekers plus employer incentives.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Exercise Veer Guardian, the IAF-Japan bilateral air drill whose second edition concluded on 22 September at Jodhpur, featured the first-ever visit to India by which Japanese fighters?
questions.e: Japan's F-2A fighters made their first-ever visit to India; the IAF fielded Su-30MKI, Rafale and LCA Tejas, and both air chiefs flew the Tejas.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: On 23 September, which agencies raised India's FY27 GDP growth forecast - and to what levels?
o: Fitch to 6.9%, S&P to 7%, ADB to 7%
questions.e: Fitch raised to 6.9% (from 6.4%), S&P to 7% (from 6.6%), ADB to 7% (from 6.6%) after 7.8% growth in the June quarter.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: Luke Lindberg was appointed Executive Director of which UN agency on 18 September?
questions.e: Lindberg succeeds Cindy McCain at the Rome-headquartered World Food Programme (Nobel Peace Prize 2020) for a five-year term, as its youngest-ever leader.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: India became the first South Asian country to host the World Circular Economy Forum. Where was WCEF 2026 (15-18 September) held?
questions.e: WCEF 2026 was inaugurated at the Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with the theme 'Circular Economy: Transition for People and Prosperity'.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: The ISRO-ESA cooperative agreement was extended until which date?
questions.e: The agreement was extended to 8 January 2032, widening collaboration on space weather and human/robotic exploration.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: ISRO will set up the Advanced Radar Research Facility (IARRF) at Chandrapur, Assam, under which arm?
questions.e: The facility under ISTRAC strengthens satellite tracking, telemetry and command coverage from the Northeast, supporting Gaganyaan and navigation-satellite missions.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) platform, launched in 2023, has crossed how many registered youth users?
questions.e: MY Bharat has crossed 3 crore registered youth users - a key metric for government youth-engagement initiatives.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Bharat Taxi, flagged off by UP CM Yogi Adityanath on 23 September, runs on a zero-commission model called what?
questions.e: The cooperative-led service (Sahakar Taxi Cooperative Ltd) runs on a 'Driver is the Owner' model with zero commission, in Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Varanasi, Kanpur and Prayagraj.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Bharat Taxi was launched in how many UP cities on 23 September 2026?
questions.e: It was flagged off in five cities - Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Varanasi, Kanpur and Prayagraj - with about 40,000 drivers ('Saarthis') registered; over 10 lakh Saarthis have joined nationally since February 2026.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Under the Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana e-portal launched in UP, long-term farm loans will be available at what interest rate?
questions.e: Long-term farm loans through the UP Cooperative Rural Development Bank at 6% interest (down from 11%), targeting 5 lakh small and marginal farmers.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: India's installed solar capacity has risen to nearly how much?
questions.e: Installed solar capacity is nearly 165 GW, with the PM Surya Ghar scheme empowering over 51 lakh families.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The PM Surya Ghar scheme has empowered over how many families?
questions.e: Over 51 lakh families have been empowered under the PM Surya Ghar scheme as solar capacity nears 165 GW.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Who was re-elected as President of the News Broadcasters & Digital Association (NBDA) for 2026-27?
questions.e: India TV Chairman & Editor-in-Chief Rajat Sharma was unanimously re-elected; NBDA is the apex body of 29 broadcasters running 130+ channels.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: On 24 September the BJP named in-charges for all 36 states and UTs. Which states were assigned to Smriti Irani?
questions.e: National general secretary Smriti Irani gets Haryana and Chhattisgarh; vice-president Ram Madhav gets Tamil Nadu and Uttarakhand.

questions.subject: Awards
questions.q: The WION Iconic Tourism Summit & Awards 2026 was presented by VFS Global in association with whom?
questions.e: Held on 23 September at ITC Maurya, New Delhi, it was presented by VFS Global in association with Red Hat Communications.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: INS Trishul reached Toulon, France, for which edition of Exercise VARUNA, the bilateral naval drill with France?
questions.e: The 24th edition of VARUNA (begun in 2001) followed a 14-17 September port call at Alexandria, Egypt, with a PASSEX alongside ENS Bernees.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: Which US Ambassador witnessed the 22nd edition of Exercise Yudh Abhyas in Rajasthan?
questions.e: US Ambassador Sergio Gor witnessed the drill at the Mahajan Field Firing Range, where Indian and US troops did joint artillery drills.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: CDS General N.S. Raja Subramani stressed that integrating which three elements is central to strengthening India's defence ecosystem?
questions.e: He stressed the triad of technology, data and industry as driving the armed forces' modernisation doctrine.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: At its 215th board meeting on 24 September, SEBI fixed the annual interest on disgorgement at what rate?
questions.e: SEBI's 215th board meeting in Mumbai set 9% annual disgorgement interest, alongside new Portfolio Managers Regulations, 2026 and a Rs 75 crore net-worth floor for vault managers.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The United Forum of Bank Unions called a three-day nationwide strike on which dates?
questions.e: The seven unions covering roughly 90% of the banking workforce called the strike for 28-30 September, with a continuous strike from 26 October on notice.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The striking bank unions of 28-30 September demanded an option to switch from the NPS to what?
questions.e: Key demands include a five-day banking week, pension updation, a uniform DA formula, and an option to switch from NPS to the old pension scheme.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: The Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC), whose second ministerial Jaishankar presided over in New York, was launched by India in which country in 2014?
questions.e: Launched by India in Fiji in 2014, FIPIC reviewed the 12-Point Action Plan announced by PM Modi in 2023.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: FSSAI's draft amendment on analogue paneer invites objections and suggestions within how many days of gazette publication?
questions.e: The draft (notified 22 September, gazetted 23 September) would add 'paneer made of constituents not derived from milk' to restricted products; objections are invited within 60 days.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The draft National Electricity Policy 2026, now before the Cabinet, was prepared by which ministry?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
questions.e: The Power Ministry's draft sets the overarching power-sector strategy on generation, transmission and distribution.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The second rail-cum-road bridge over the Brahmaputra at Saraighat, Assam, falls under which railway zone?
questions.e: The bridge and the Agthori-Kamakhya track doubling fall under the Northeast Frontier Railway zone.

questions.subject: Science & Tech
questions.q: Electronics Secretary S. Krishnan announced that what percentage of India's mobile phone demand is now made within the country?
questions.e: 99.2% of the mobile phones India needs are now made domestically - a landmark for electronics self-reliance.

questions.subject: Miscellaneous
questions.q: For NEET-PG 2026, what was the category cut-off for General/EWS candidates?
questions.e: Results were declared 24 September for the 30 August exam (2,63,544 candidates); cut-offs: General/EWS 262 (50th percentile), General-PwBD 244, SC/ST/OBC 226.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: On day six of the Asian Games 2026, Seema Kumari's bronze in the women's 10,000m was significant because it was what?
o: India's first athletics medal of the Games
questions.e: Her bronze was India's first athletics medal of the Games; India took five medals on day six (2 silver, 3 bronze) for a tally of 17.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The India-New Zealand FTA will enter into force on which date?
questions.e: Announced by Piyush Goyal, the pact - formalised on 27 April 2026 by Goyal and NZ Trade Minister Todd McClay - gives 100% of India's exports to NZ duty-free access.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Fitch Ratings raised India's FY27 growth forecast by 50 basis points to what level?
questions.e: Fitch raised it to 6.9%, citing stronger-than-expected expansion; India grew 7.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The Rs 810.79 crore contract for 160 SAT-SAAW systems with BDL was signed under which procurement category?
questions.e: Signed on 23 September in New Delhi under Buy (Indian-IDDM); the DRDO-developed air-to-ground precision glide bomb has 60% indigenous content.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: The 18th edition of the India-Mongolia joint exercise Nomadic Elephant began at Pithoragarh with how many personnel from each side?
questions.e: 45 personnel from each side; training covers counter-insurgency under a UN mandate, drone ops, cybersecurity and cordon-and-search.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: At the third National Conference of ANTF heads, Home Minister Amit Shah set the target of a drug-free India by which date?
questions.e: The conference will implement the Vision Document on Narcotics Control (2026-2029), targeting a drug-free India by 31 December 2029 in line with Viksit Bharat 2047.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: India's National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission (2023) has an elimination target year of what?
questions.e: The mission targets elimination by 2047; India showcased it at the OneSCD global partnership co-launched in New York - 72.9 million screened, 49.3 million Sickle Cell Cards issued.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: The Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY was launched by PM Modi on 23 September 2018 in which city?
questions.e: Launched at Ranchi and run by the Health Ministry, it is the world's largest government-funded public health insurance scheme with Rs 5 lakh annual cover per family.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Effective 22 September 2026, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance was renamed what?
questions.e: Renamed ICICI Life Insurance after RoC approval; Prudential plc of the UK shifts from promoter to passive investor as it plans a controlling stake in Bharti Life.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: BIS certification for smartphone screen protectors becomes mandatory from 1 April 2027 under IS 19348:2025. They become which category in the framework?
questions.e: Screen protectors become the 66th category under the Compulsory Registration Order, 2021, alongside smartphones, laptops, chargers, LED TVs and set-top boxes.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Pune was announced as host of the 2032 UCI Road World Championships, beating which bid in the final round?
questions.e: At the UCI's 195th Congress in Montreal, Pune beat Groningen/Drenthe - cycling's road world championships come to India for the first time.

questions.subject: Sports
